Industry & Market Overview • Growth Drivers: Expanding demand in packaging, automotive, agriculture, infrastructure, and wire/cable sectors. • Key Focus: High demand for high-performance polymer compounds, eco-friendly add itives, and PVC/CPVC one-pack additives in India and export markets.

Key Risks & Mitigation • Raw Material Volatility: Mitigated via strategic inventory management and l ong-term vendor contracts. • Supply Chain Risks: Mitigated by expanding global import channels and local vendor options. • Environmental Regulations: Mitigated by developing lead-free, sustainable, an d recyclable masterbatch lines.
